text:
tara_csm: Heads-up 10-day micro-save for Aperture Labs. Renewal in 12 days, DAUs down ~48%, onboarding stuck at 57%. Need a fail-safe downgrade ladder + quick enablement to try to recover.

leo_ops: Ops quick take: we can flip them to 'lite-mode' (no realtime transforms, nightly aggregates) in ~12h. Exports preserved for 45 days by default.

sam_support: Saw failed report jobs: `render-worker timeout 100s` around 2026-03-18. Filed ticket SUP-3002. Could be why teams stopped relying on scheduled reports.

remi_onboard: Offer: 20m call to walk 3 priority reports, enable lite-mode, and provide a 14-day usage credit tied to hitting 3 scheduled reports + 1 alert. I'll run the walkthrough.

kevin_fin: Approve up to one 14-day credit for retention plays if legal terms unchanged. Need standard credit wording: "pro-rated service credit for 14 days contingent on adoption milestones."

tara_csm: Proposed downgrade ladder in-thread: Step A (if no adoption): migrate to Lite plan, preserve exports + readonly API token for 45d. Step B (30d after downgrade): offer cold-archive export (opt-in) for extra 90d. Include explicit preserved artifacts list in messaging.

leo_ops: Implemented readonly token `aperture_readonly_45d`. Lite-mode switch ready. S3 path: `s3://exports/aperture/2026-03/`.

cs-bot: Task created: 'Aperture 20m enablement' assigned to remi_onboard due 2026-03-24T15:00:00Z.

sam_support: SUP-3002 root cause: intermittent render queue backlog. Temporary mitigation: bump render timeout for Aperture to 180s and monitor 24h.

tara_csm: Owners: remi -> run call + capture feedback, leo -> enable lite-mode + confirm exports, sam -> monitor SUP-3002, kevin -> finalize credit wording.

remi_onboard: Scheduling call now. Will drop 3-question feedback and ask for permission to record.

tara_csm: Thanks. If we don't see lift after the call, we execute the downgrade ladder and send the migration note. Keep updates short here. :handshake:
